beats.text: Six signs you're a deep thinker — for better and worse.
One. Small talk drains you, but a real conversation can keep you up for hours.
Two. You need time alone to recharge and to actually hear yourself think.
Three. You notice patterns and details that most people walk straight past.
Four. You ask 'why' long after everyone else has moved on to the next thing.
Five. You replay and analyse — sometimes to insight, sometimes straight into overthinking.
Six. The big questions — meaning, death, time — don't scare you off. They pull you in.
Deep thinking is a gift and a weight. The skill is knowing when to think — and when to just live.
